title: Hide page title in content; full width default

entries.summary: Removed automatic h1 page title from public/page.php (homepage and inner). Title still used for document title, SEO, nav, breadcrumbs; builder headings own the content.
Added full (1320px) content width; PublicTheme default and normalizeWidth fallback are full. Migration 019 sets pub_theme_width to full when missing or narrow.
pages.php, general.php, CONFIGURATION, DEVELOPMENTGUIDE, CHANGES updated.
